items.reason: Three strata: recurrent medulloblastoma, newly diagnosed HGG '(such as anaplastic astrocytoma, glioblastoma, H3K27-altered DMG)' and DIPG. Medulloblastoma is a non-glioma cancer, so this is a multi-tumour trial with GBM named in the inclusion criteria (basket), not only a mix of glioma types.

note: Outcome-neutral: only investigational agent is the PEP-CMV peptide vaccine (excluded type), so S6 fails either way. Td toxoid is part of the vaccine therapy (D30-R4/D31-B8, excluded_intervention_type). Temozolomide stays soc_backbone: the record calls it 'standard chemotherapy' and states no immune-priming purpose, so D31-B8 does not apply. Ages 3-39 (mixed_age). Basket coding now settled by D31-B15. Nothing pending for XL.
